title: SF Apartment Finder
claim: Product Hunt: SF Apartment Finder — Tinder for live SF rentals from across the web
why_good: A 'Tinder for SF rentals' aggregating live listings across the web — a real, painful, high-intent problem (finding housing in SF).
value: Rentals monetize well (lead-gen, broker fees, premium alerts); high-intent users in a high-price market pay.
risk: Hyper-local (SF only), listing access is a legal/ToS fight (Zillow/Craigslist), and it must expand beyond one city.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: SF Apartment Finder —— 聚合全网旧金山实时房源的 租房版 Tinder。
zh.why_good: 一个聚合全网旧金山实时房源的租房版 Tinder——真实、痛、高意图的问题(在旧金山找房)。
zh.value: 租房很好变现(导流、中介费、付费提醒);高价市场里的高意图用户会付费。
zh.risk: 超本地(仅 SF)、房源抓取是法律/ToS 之争(Zillow/Craigslist),且必须扩出单一城市。
